retention.budget_series: per-name peak used against its limit, with the sample count; individual budget records are not retained
retention.case_outcomes: fairness, reference_state, overload_outcome and observers_detached are kept whole: they are what their cases exist to produce, and a summary of them is not evidence
retention.identity: hoisted to the artifact once; fields that vary per trial are under each trial as `run`, and any trial whose shared half differed is listed in `identity_divergent_trials` rather than silently merged
retention.latency_distribution: full histogram trimmed to its occupied bucket span; bucket width, count, ceiling and overflow count retained
retention.not_retained: per-producer ledger rows (totalled), individual budget records, and per-process rows for non-resource cases outside the closing census
retention.process_rows: kept whole at measurement_end and at the closing census - steady state and the quiescence that must follow it - and only for cases named in full_process_rows, except the closing census which is kept for every case because it is the cleanup proof
retention.resource_series: every periodic census reduced to tree totals over time, which is what shows accumulation

summary.note: macOS re-run of the six cases that lost trials in Experiment 0005
